title: How Long Do Dental Implants Take: Timeline & Guide
seoTitle: How Long Do Dental Implants Take? Full Timeline
seoDescription: Implant treatment runs about 3 months in ideal cases and 6 to 12 months when grafting is needed. See each phase and plan your timeline in Valencia.
excerpt: From consultation to final crown: realistic implant timelines for immediate, staged and full-arch cases, and what each phase involves.
keyTakeaways: Treatment commonly takes about 3 months for ideal immediate-placement cases and 6 to 12 months when grafting is needed.
Osseointegration is the rate-limiting step: roughly 3 months in the lower jaw and 4 to 6 months in the upper jaw.
Small grafts heal in about three months; larger augmentations or sinus lifts commonly need four to six months.
Immediate loading gives a same-day tooth when bone and stability allow; staged treatment trades time for predictability.
Smoking, uncontrolled diabetes and poor hygiene raise risk; quitting and glycemic control can shorten and de-risk treatment.
